terms.title: Booking terms
sections: Who you are booking with

Andaman Travel Planner Private Limited (CIN U52291AN2025PTC006133, GSTIN 35ABCCA3774B1Z0, DPIIT Recognised Startup DIPP222255), registered office at Bargat Line, Chakargaon, Sri Vijaya Puram (Port Blair), South Andaman, Andaman & Nicobar Islands – 744112, books each part of your trip with the partner who provides it: the hotel, the ferry operator, the cab partner or the activity partner. We take one payment and pay each partner their share.
Prices
Prices are in rupees. GST is shown separately before you pay. We check every price again at the moment you pay; if a price has changed, we show you before taking money.
Confirmation
Each booking is confirmed by its partner after payment. If a partner cannot confirm, that part is refunded in full to your original payment method, and we offer a similar option.
Travellers and ID
Ferry operators need each traveller’s name, age and gender. Every traveller must carry the photo ID given at checkout.
Changes
You can change dates, people or items before travel. Each change follows that booking’s rules, shown on the booking.
Weather and sea conditions
Ferries and water activities can be cancelled by the operator or the port authority for weather. You then get a full refund for that booking, or a new time where one is free.

refunds.title: Refunds and cancellation
sections: Flexible bookings (cabs and most activities)
Full refund until 24 hours before the start. No refund after that.
Hotels
Full refund until 72 hours before check-in. Half until 24 hours before. No refund in the last 24 hours.
Ferries
Each operator’s own published rules apply, shown on the ticket before you pay.
Government entry fees
Refunded only if the authority refunds them.
How refunds are paid
To the original payment method within 5–7 working days of cancellation. You can see each refund in Profile → Payments and refunds.

privacy.title: Privacy
sections: What we collect
Names, ages, gender and ID details of travellers (needed by ferry operators), your WhatsApp number and email, and your bookings.
Why
To make and manage your bookings, send tickets and updates on WhatsApp, and issue GST invoices.
Who sees it
Only the partner who provides each booking gets the details it needs. We do not sell your data.
Payments
Card and bank details are handled by Razorpay. We never see or store them.
Your choices
You can ask for a copy of your data or for it to be deleted, except what tax law requires us to keep, by writing to info@andamantravelplanner.com.
